question: By whom and under what condition is this knowledge to be taken up?
premises: It is to be taken up by effort.
It belongs to the Kaula domain.
It is to be taken up by one who desires accomplishment.
inference: One who desires accomplishment must take it up with effort in the Kaula path.
plain_english: It is to be taken up with effort in the Kaula path by one who desires accomplishment.
